title: SDR daily scratchpad - Zoe Klein - 2026-03-04
content:
Morning run-through (short):
- ARR target: 380k this quarter. My pipeline coverage = 2.8x. Need 3.5x to be comfortable.
- Daily outbound goal: 40 activities (calls + emails + LinkedIn). Yesterday = 37.
- Follow-up priority: Product infra + Platform eng leads first, then GTM ops.

Today top tasks:
1) Call blitz 9:00-10:30 AM: top 12 accounts (see list). Focus on re-engage + qualify.
2) Send tailored follow-ups to demo attendees (Tue) by 11:30 AM. Use template: quick value + next-step CTA.
3) Update HubSpot notes for AE handoffs (tag Ethan). 3 warm opps ready for AE review.
4) Prep for 3:00 PM sync with Ethan (confirm demo slots, objection handling).
5) Quick research on QuantifyLabs (account on list) - find recent funding/news, decision-makers.

Call list (order = high -> low priority):
- QuantifyLabs (CEO: Ashwin Rao) - follow-up, spoke 2/25, interested in Dedicated; asked for cost/latency benchmarks. Action: send tailored cost slide + ask for availability for demo.
- Meridian HealthTech (Dir Eng: Priya Shah) - voicemail left 3/2, asked about private deployment options. Action: email + ask if infra team wants short architecture walkthrough.
- Beacon Retail (Head of Data: Marco Alvarez) - warm, requested integration notes for POS data. Action: send integration checklist + ask for EOM pilot timeline.
- AtlasFin (VP Product: Jenna Park) - cold outreach, inbound MQL. Action: qualify on compliance needs (KMS/HSM) + set demo.
- Nimbus AI (CTO: Omar Salim) - low response, try LinkedIn touch.
- Redwood Labs (internal partner) - coordinate on case study ask.

Follow-ups and templates: 
- Quick demo follow-up (subject): Thanks + 15-min next step?
  Body: Thanks for your time today - re: [pain], we can help w/ [value]. Attached: latency/cost snapshot + sample config. Are you free Wed/Thu for 15-min to align?

- Pricing follow-up (short): Re: Dedicated pricing - attaching the dedicated overview. Note: committed monthly guarantees better unit cost; mention autoscale burst.

Notes to self / shorthand: 
- Ask infra-friendly questions on calls: seq len distribution? peak qps? avg prompt size?
- If they care about cost, call out Optimize suggestions: batching + prefix cache + int8 quantization.
- For compliance customers, call out Private + KMS/HSM + audit logs.

Pipeline quick hits (HubSpot IDs):
- HS-2345 (QuantifyLabs) - Stage: Proposal, est. ARR $72k, next step: pricing send, due: 2026-03-11
- HS-2401 (Meridian HealthTech) - Stage: Discovery, est. ARR $45k, next: architecture sync with infra, due: 2026-03-18
- HS-2410 (Beacon Retail) - Stage: Demo Completed, est. ARR $18k, next: pilot agreement draft

3pm sync agenda w/ Ethan:
- Review 3 warm opps for AE handoff
- Demo availability next week (Wed/Thu)
- Support ask: engineering contact for Meridian architecture call
- Quick role play: objection on vendor lock-in + pricing comps

Open questions / blockers:
- Need updated dedicated pricing slide (last updated Feb) - ping Product for latest numbers (tag @Maya).
- Waiting on legal for case study NDA with Redwood Labs - blocks outbound quoting for them.

Random notes / snippets to copy into templates later:
- "Redwood gives predictable latency with dedicated pools + autoscaling; you only pay for what you reserve and can burst when needed."
- "For compliance workflows, customers deploy Redwood Private with KMS to meet SOC2/ISO controls."

Quick checklist (tick when done):
[ ] 9am call blitz executed
[ ] Send 3 demo follow-ups by 11:30am
[ ] Update HS notes for 3 opps
[ ] Ping product for pricing slide
[ ] Prep Meridian architecture slides

End-of-day self-review (fill in later):
- Activities completed: 
- Meetings booked: 
- Notes to transfer to Confluence (if needed): link to weekly SDR playbook + call scripts (Confluence ID: CONF-789)

Slack bookmarks / reminders: 
- #sales-ops: ask about updated pricing table
- #product-hosted-api: find latest benchmarks for 8k seq length

Short script snippets for calls: 
- Opener: "Hi {name}, Zoe from Redwood Inference - quick question about how you're currently serving LLMs in prod?"
- Qualify: "What's the typical workload shape? peak qps, avg prompt length, number of concurrent users?"
- Close: "If we can show you a 30% unit cost improvement without changing model quality, worth a 15-min demo?"

Notes-to-self: keep notes tidy in HS after each call. If warm, set task for AE + tag Ethan. If technical ask, route to eng-support@redwood.com and CC Ethan.

-- end of scratchpad --
